item.title: Detected Resolved: Impact to Checkout and Multiple API's (PP-LIVE-110644)
item.content:encoded:
Detected Resolved:

We were experiencing outage affecting Refunds, Authorizations, Billing Agreements, Captures, Orders, Express Checkout APIs, Online Checkout, Retail Checkout, Crypto. Our engineers have resolved the issue, and the impact has been mitigated.

Affected Regions: Global

item.title: Completed: Hyperwallet (PP-LIVE-110014)
item.content:encoded:
Completed:

We would like to inform you that Hyperwallet scheduled maintenance in Production environment has completed successfully.


All Hyperwallet Payout Services are back online and available.


Oct 25, 09:25 UTC

Rescheduled:

This is to inform you that the previously communicated Hyperwallet maintenance has been changed to 11:00 PM Saturday, 24 October up to 5:00 AM PDT Sunday, 25 October (06:00 UTC up to 12:00 UTC on Sunday, 25 October 2026). You will be notified once the maintenance is complete.


During this scheduled maintenance, all Hyperwallet Payout Services in Production will be offline and unavailable. This will impact API calls, Control Panel, Pay Portal and batch file upload and processing.


We sincerely apologize for any inconvenience this may cause.


Oct 15, 16:18 UTC

Initial Notification:

On Saturday, Oct 17th, 2026 (2:00PM to 8:00PM PDT), Hyperwallet will be undergoing a 6-hour scheduled maintenance in our Production environment.


During this scheduled maintenance, all Hyperwallet Payout Services in Production will be offline and unavailable. This will impact API calls, Control Panel, Web Portal and batch file upload and processing.


We sincerely apologize for any inconveniences this may cause.


Sep 28, 23:32 UTC
